subject: TOURNAMENT QA-03 (MEDIUM): the tournament hint button advertises a point cost it never charges - no server-side hint accounting exists anywhere, so 'Hint 1 (-10 pts)' is a promise the platform does not keep
description:
Found 2026-09-17 during the A-to-Z tournament QA. Measured, not inherited from the docs.

WHAT THE STUDENT SEES: _app/arena/tournament-board.html:843 renders the button label as 'Hint ' + (i+1) + ' (-' + hint.cost + ' pts)'. So a challenge with hints advertises an explicit price per hint.

WHAT ACTUALLY HAPPENS: window.revealHint at tournament-board.html:882 only un-hides the hint text (toggles the .revealed class on #hintText{idx}). It makes NO server call. Grep for hint accounting on the server returns nothing: no hintPenalty, no hintsUsed, no hintCost anywhere in functions/index.js or functions/ctf-*.js. ctfSubmitFlag credits the challenge's full points regardless of how many hints were opened. So the cost is never deducted, never recorded, and no consumer could reconstruct it later.

WHY IT MATTERS BEYOND TIDINESS: (a) it is a false statement to a student mid-competition, in a feature whose placements mint badges (task 364) and are intended to back retroactively issued credentials (_docs/architecture/hexworth-credential-authority.md); (b) two teams with identical scores may have used a different number of hints and the standings cannot tell them apart, so the tie-break (functions/ctf-standings-rule.js, BUG-022) resolves on solve time with hint usage invisible; (c) _docs/features/TOURNAMENT_SYSTEM.md calls this a 'known gap' and describes hintPenalty on the team doc as never decremented - that field does not exist at all now, so even the documented description of the gap is wrong.

PRECEDENT: solo boxes have a validator for exactly this class - BOX-010 'hint Help Level honesty' in the EduScan box rules. Tournament challenges are not covered by it. Whatever the fix, the validator gap is the reason this was invisible.

TWO HONEST FIX OPTIONS, operator/vote decides which:
1. CHARGE IT: record hint reveals server-side (a callable, or fold into ctfSubmitFlag's credit transaction) and deduct at credit time. Correct competitively, and it makes hint usage available to the tie-break and to post-event forensics. More moving parts, and it needs a decision about whether a revealed hint costs points even on an unsolved challenge.
2. STOP CLAIMING IT: remove the cost from the label so the UI states what the system does. One line, honest immediately, and loses the pedagogical pressure the cost was meant to create.
Do NOT ship a client-side deduction - the score is server-authoritative and a client-computed penalty is not a penalty (see the no-client-grading rule).
